notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
xsltproc converts Nmap's XML output (-oX or -oA .xml) to formatted HTML using Nmap's embedded XSL stylesheet. Produces a structured table with port states, service versions, script output — suitable for client reports.

=== CHAINING ===
Every nmap scan with -oA → .xml file → xsltproc nmap.xml -o nmap.html → open in browser → structured evidence for reporting.

=== REPORT USE ===
HTML table format is readable by non-technical stakeholders. Include in penetration test reports as appendix evidence. Preserves all scan data in structured format.
